milestones.title: Campaign Brief
milestones.goal: Capture the campaign window, objective, and what to feature so downstream steps stay aligned.
milestones.data:
## Campaign Brief

**Start date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
**End date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
**Campaign objective:** <!-- e.g. Drive weekday lunch covers -->
**Primary offer or theme:** <!-- e.g. New dessert menu launch -->
**Key menu items to feature:** <!-- comma-separated names -->
**Target guest:** <!-- e.g. weekday office lunch crowd -->
**Budget or post cadence:** <!-- e.g. 3 posts/week, no paid ads -->
**Special events or dates in window:** <!-- e.g. Public holiday on DD/MM -->

passCriteria.requirement: Start date is specified (YYYY-MM-DD or clear equivalent).
End date is specified and is on or after the start date.
Campaign objective is stated in one or two sentences.
At least one key menu item to feature is listed.

milestones.title: Brand Brief
milestones.goal: Define content pillars, tone, and audience hypotheses from POS data for this campaign.

passCriteria.requirement: Content pillars are defined (typically 3–5) and tied to menu or operating signals.
Tone guardrails are documented (bullet list or short section).
Audience hypotheses are grounded in operating data (peaks, meal periods), not invented demographics.

milestones.title: Instagram Campaign Schedule
milestones.goal: Generate an analytics-backed per-post schedule for the campaign window.

passCriteria.requirement: Schedule covers the full campaign window from the Campaign Brief (start through end).
Each planned post slot names at least one featured menu item.
Suggested posting times or windows reference analytics signals (e.g. bestPostingWindow) where data exists.
